observation: Read all2861selected characters. The paper begins with competing users and environmental conditions, then gives a two-model roadmap. A shared reservoir-height/volume analysis precedes both models. ModelI is built as a transport optimization with objective, constraints, geography/transfer direction, transport losses and a maintenance-time algorithm; the numeric lake-level result is handed to Section5.4. ModelII explicitly extends ModelI to three user groups and switches from economic-only treatment in normal conditions to three-effect multi-objective planning in shortage. Mexico's rights are an additional branch with its own remaining-resource condition. The closing lists sensitivity inputs without outcomes. Form labels remain and punctuation/line-wrap defects are retained without source or model correction.
